v.t: Alif, Lam, Meem
v.l: Alif-Lam-Mim

v.t: The Romans have been defeated
v.l: Ghulibati Ar-Rumu

v.t: In a nearby territory. But following their defeat, they will be victorious
v.l: Fi 'Adna Al-'Arđi Wa Hum Min Ba`di Ghalabihim Sayaghlibuna

v.t: In a few years. The matter is up to God, in the past, and in the future. On that day, the believers will rejoice
v.l: Fi Biđ`i Sinina Lillahi Al-'Amru Min Qablu Wa Min Ba`du Wa Yawma'idhin Yafrahu Al-Mu'uminuna

v.t: In God’s support. He supports whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, the Merciful
v.l: Binasri Allahi Yansuru Man Yasha'u Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Ar-Rahimu

v.t: The promise of God—God never breaks His promise, but most people do not know
v.l: Wa`da Allahi La Yukhlifu Allahu Wa`dahu Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: They know an outer aspect of the worldly life, but they are heedless of the Hereafter
v.l: Ya`lamuna Zahiraan Mina Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Hum `Ani Al-'Akhirati Hum Ghafiluna

v.t: Do they not reflect within themselves? God did not create the heavens and the earth, and what is between them, except with reason, and for a specific duration. But most people, regarding meeting their Lord, are disbelievers
v.l: Awalam Yatafakkaru Fi 'Anfusihim Ma Khalaqa Allahu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma 'Illa Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Ajalin Musammaan Wa 'Inna Kathiraan Mina An-Nasi Biliqa'i Rabbihim Lakafiruna

v.t: Have they not travelled the earth and seen how those before them ended up? They were more powerful than them, and they cultivated the land and developed it more than they developed it, and their messengers came to them with clear signs. God would never wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves
v.l: Awalam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fayanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Kanu 'Ashadda Minhum Quwatan Wa 'Atharu Al-'Arđa Wa `Amaruha 'Akthara Mimma `Amaruha Wa Ja'at/hum Rusuluhum Bil-Bayyinati Fama Kana Allahu Liyazlimahum Wa Lakin Kanu 'Anfusahum Yazlimuna

v.t: Then, evil was the end of those who committed evil. That is because they rejected God’s revelations, and used to ridicule them
v.l: Thumma Kana `Aqibata Al-Ladhina 'Asa'u As-Su'a 'An Kadhabu Bi'ayati Allahi Wa Kanu Biha Yastahzi'un

v.t: God originates creation, and then repeats it. Then to Him you will be returned
v.l: Allahu Yabda'u Al-Khalqa Thumma Yu`iduhu Thumma 'Ilayhi Turja`una

v.t: On the Day when the Hour takes place, the guilty will despair
v.l: Wa Yawma Taqumu As-Sa`atu Yublisu Al-Mujrimuna

v.t: They will have no intercessors from among their idols, and they will disown their partners
v.l: Wa Lam Yakun Lahum Min Shuraka'ihim Shufa`a'u Wa Kanu Bishuraka'ihim Kafirina

v.t: On the Day when the Hour takes place—on that Day they will separate
v.l: Wa Yawma Taqumu As-Sa`atu Yawma'idhin Yatafarraquna

v.t: As for those who believed and did good deeds—they will be delighted in meadows
v.l: Fa'amma Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Fahum Fi Rawđatin Yuhbaruna

v.t: But as for those who disbelieved, and rejected Our signs and the encounter of the Hereafter—those will be hauled into the torment
v.l: Wa 'Amma Al-Ladhina Kafaru Wa Kadhabu Bi'ayatina Wa Liqa'i Al-'Akhirati Fa'ula'ika Fi Al-`Adhabi Muhđaruna

v.t: So glorify God when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning
v.l: Fasubhana Allahi Hina Tumsuna Wa Hina Tusbihuna

v.t: His is the praise in the heavens and on earth, and in the evening, and when you reach midday
v.l: Wa Lahu Al-Hamdu Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa `Ashiyaan Wa Hina Tuzhiruna

v.t: He brings the living out of the dead, and He brings the dead out of the living, and He revives the land after it had died. Likewise you will be resurrected
v.l: Yukhriju Al-Hayya Mina Al-Mayyiti Wa Yukhriju Al-Mayyita Mina Al-Hayyi Wa Yuhyi Al-'Arđa Ba`da Mawtiha Wa Kadhalika Tukhrajuna

v.t: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; and behold, you become humans spreading out
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi 'An Khalaqakum Min Turabin Thumma 'Idha 'Antum Basharun Tantashiruna

v.t: And of His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, so that you may find tranquility in them; and He planted love and compassion between you. In this are signs for people who reflect
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi 'An Khalaqa Lakum Min 'Anfusikum 'Azwajaan Litaskunu 'Ilayha Wa Ja`ala Baynakum Mawaddatan Wa Rahmatan 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Yatafakkaruna

v.t: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of your languages and colors. In this are signs for those who know
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi Khalqu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Akhtilafu 'Alsinatikum Wa 'Alwanikum 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Lil`alimina

v.t: And of His signs are your sleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His bounty. In this are signs for people who listen
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi Manamukum Bil-Layli Wa An-Nahari Wa Abtigha'uukum Min Fađlihi 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Yasma`una

v.t: And of His signs is that He shows you the lightning, causing fear and hope. And He brings down water from the sky, and with it He revives the earth after it was dead. In this are signs for people who understand
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi Yurikumu Al-Barqa Khawfaan Wa Tama`aan Wa Yunazzilu Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fayuhyi Bihi Al-'Arđa Ba`da Mawtiha 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Ya`qiluna

v.t: And of His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand at His disposal. And then, when He calls you out of the earth, you will emerge at once
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi 'An Taquma As-Sama'u Wa Al-'Arđu Bi'amrihi Thumma 'Idha Da`akum Da`watan Mina Al-'Arđi 'Idha 'Antum Takhrujuna

v.t: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. All are submissive to Him
v.l: Wa Lahu Man Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Kullun Lahu Qanituna

v.t: It is He who initiates creation, and then repeats it, something easy for Him. His is the highest attribute, in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise
v.l: Wa Huwa Al-Ladhi Yabda'u Al-Khalqa Thumma Yu`iduhu Wa Huwa 'Ahwanu `Alayhi Wa Lahu Al-Mathalu Al-'A`la Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Huwa Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: He illustrates an example for you, from your own selves: do you make your servants full partners in the wealth We have given you? Do you revere them as you revere one another? We thus explain the revelations for a people who understand
v.l: Đaraba Lakum Mathalaan Min 'Anfusikum Hal Lakum Min Ma Malakat 'Aymanukum Min Shuraka'a Fi Ma Razaqnakum Fa'antum Fihi Sawa'un Takhafunahum Kakhifatikum 'Anfusakum Kadhalika Nufassilu Al-'Ayati Liqawmin Ya`qiluna

v.t: Yet the wrongdoers follow their desires without knowledge. But who can guide whom God leaves astray? They will have no helpers
v.l: Bal Attaba`a Al-Ladhina Zalamu 'Ahwa'ahum Bighayri `Ilmin Faman Yahdi Man 'Ađalla Allahu Wa Ma Lahum Min Nasirina

v.t: So devote yourself to the religion of monotheism—the natural instinct God has instilled in mankind. There is no altering God’s creation. This is the true religion, but most people do not know
v.l: Fa'aqim Wajhaka Lilddini Hanifaan Fitrata Allahi Allati Fatara An-Nasa `Alayha La Tabdila Likhalqi Allahi Dhalika Ad-Dinu Al-Qayyimu Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: Turning towards Him—and be conscious of Him, and perform the prayer, and do not be of the idolaters
v.l: Munibina 'Ilayhi Wa Attaquhu Wa 'Aqimu As-Salaata Wa La Takunu Mina Al-Mushrikina

v.t: Of those who divided their religion, and became sects; each faction pleased with what they have
v.l: Mina Al-Ladhina Farraqu Dinahum Wa Kanu Shiya`aan Kullu Hizbin Bima Ladayhim Farihuna

v.t: When affliction touches the people, they call on their Lord, turning to Him in repentance. But then, when He gives them a taste of His mercy, some of them attribute partners to their Lord
v.l: Wa 'Idha Massa An-Nasa Đurrun Da`aw Rabbahum Munibina 'Ilayhi Thumma 'Idha 'Adhaqahum Minhu Rahmatan 'Idha Fariqun Minhum Birabbihim Yushrikuna

v.t: To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Indulge yourselves—you will surely know
v.l: Liyakfuru Bima 'Ataynahum Fatamatta`u Fasawfa Ta`lamuna

v.t: Have We sent down to them any authority, which speaks in support of their idols
v.l: Am 'Anzalna `Alayhim Sultanaan Fahuwa Yatakallamu Bima Kanu Bihi Yushrikuna

v.t: When We give people a taste of mercy, they rejoice in it. But when adversity befalls them, because of what their hands have perpetrated, they begin to despair
v.l: Wa 'Idha 'Adhaqna An-Nasa Rahmatan Farihu Biha Wa 'In Tusibhum Sayyi'atun Bima Qaddamat 'Aydihim 'Idha Hum Yaqnatuna

v.t: Do they not see that God expands the provision for whomever He wills, or restricts it? Surely in this are signs for people who believe
v.l: Awalam Yaraw 'Anna Allaha Yabsutu Ar-Rizqa Liman Yasha'u Wa Yaqdiru 'Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Liqawmin Yu'uminuna

v.t: So give the relative his rights, and the destitute, and the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek God’s presence. Those are the prosperous
v.l: Fa'ati Dha Al-Qurba Haqqahu Wa Al-Miskina Wa Abna As-Sabili Dhalika Khayrun Lilladhina Yuriduna Wajha Allahi Wa 'Ula'ika Humu Al-Muflihuna

v.t: The usury you practice, seeking thereby to multiply people’s wealth, will not multiply with God. But what you give in charity, desiring God’s approval—these are the multipliers
v.l: Wa Ma 'Ataytum Min Ribaan Liyarbuwa Fi 'Amwali An-Nasi Fala Yarbu `Inda Allahi Wa Ma 'Ataytum Min Zakaatin Turiduna Wajha Allahi Fa'ula'ika Humu Al-Muđ`ifuna

v.t: God is He who created you, then provides for you, then makes you die, then brings you back to life. Can any of your idols do any of that? Glorified is He, and Exalted above what they associate
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Khalaqakum Thumma Razaqakum Thumma Yumitukum Thumma Yuhyikum Hal Min Shuraka'ikum Man Yaf`alu Min Dhalikum Min Shay'in Subhanahu Wa Ta`ala `Amma Yushrikuna
w: He will cause you to die

v.t: Corruption has appeared on land and sea, because of what people’s hands have earned, in order to make them taste some of what they have done, so that they might return
v.l: Zahara Al-Fasadu Fi Al-Barri Wa Al-Bahri Bima Kasabat 'Aydi An-Nasi Liyudhiqahum Ba`đa Al-Ladhi `Amilu La`allahum Yarji`una
w: so that He may let them taste

v.t: Say, “Roam the earth, and observe the fate of those who came before. Most of them were idolaters.”
v.l: Qul Siru Fi Al-'Arđi Fanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Min Qablu Kana 'Aktharuhum Mushrikina

v.t: So devote yourself to the upright religion, before there comes from God a Day that cannot be averted. On that Day, they will be shocked
v.l: Fa'aqim Wajhaka Lilddini Al-Qayyimi Min Qabli 'An Ya'tiya Yawmun La Maradda Lahu Mina Allahi Yawma'idhin Yassadda`una

v.t: Whoever disbelieves, upon him falls his disbelief. And whoever acts righteously—they are preparing for themselves
v.l: Man Kafara Fa`alayhi Kufruhu Wa Man `Amila Salihaan Fali'anfusihim Yamhaduna

v.t: So that He may reward those who have believed and done the righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not love the ungrateful
v.l: Liyajziya Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Min Fađlihi 'Innahu La Yuhibbu Al-Kafirina

v.t: And of His signs is that He sends the winds bearing good news, to give you a taste of His mercy, and so that the ships may sail by His command, and so that you may seek of His bounty, and so that you may give thanks
v.l: Wa Min 'Ayatihi 'An Yursila Ar-Riyaha Mubashiratin Wa Liyudhiqakum Min Rahmatihi Wa Litajriya Al-Fulku Bi'amrihi Wa Litabtaghu Min Fađlihi Wa La`allakum Tashkuruna

v.t: Before you, We sent messengers to their people. They came to them with clear proofs. Then We took revenge on those who sinned. It is incumbent on Us to help the believers
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Min Qablika Rusulaan 'Ila Qawmihim Faja'uhum Bil-Bayyinati Fantaqamna Mina Al-Ladhina 'Ajramu Wa Kana Haqqaan `Alayna Nasru Al-Mu'uminina

v.t: God is He who sends the winds. They stir up clouds. Then He spreads them in the sky as He wills. And He breaks them apart. Then you see rain drops issuing from their midst. Then, when He makes it fall upon whom He wills of His servants, behold, they rejoice
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Yursilu Ar-Riyaha Fatuthiru Sahabaan Fayabsutuhu Fi As-Sama'i Kayfa Yasha'u Wa Yaj`aluhu Kisafaan Fatara Al-Wadqa Yakhruju Min Khilalihi Fa'idha 'Asaba Bihi Man Yasha'u Min `Ibadihi 'Idha Hum Yastabshiruna
w: He causes it to fall on
He causes it to fall on

v.t: Although they were before this—before it was sent down upon them—in despair
v.l: Wa 'In Kanu Min Qabli 'An Yunazzala `Alayhim Min Qablihi Lamublisina

v.t: So observe the effects of God’s mercy—how He revives the earth after it was dead. Indeed, He is the Reviver of the dead. He is Capable of everything
v.l: Fanzur 'Ila 'Athari Rahmati Allahi Kayfa Yuhyi Al-'Arđa Ba`da Mawtiha 'Inna Dhalika Lamuhyi Al-Mawta Wa Huwa `Ala Kulli Shay'in Qadirun

v.t: But if We send a wind, and they see it turning things yellow, they would continue thereafter to disbelieve
v.l: Wa La'in 'Arsalna Rihaan Fara'awhu Musfarraan Lazallu Min Ba`dihi Yakfuruna

v.t: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away
v.l: Fa'innaka La Tusmi`u Al-Mawta Wa La Tusmi`u As-Summa Ad-Du`a'a 'Idha Wa Llaw Mudbirina

v.t: Nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make hear only those who believe in Our signs, and so have submitted
v.l: Wa Ma 'Anta Bihadi Al-`Umyi `An Đalalatihim 'In Tusmi`u 'Illa Man Yu'uminu Bi'ayatina Fahum Muslimun

v.t: God is He Who created you weak, then after weakness gave you strength, then after strength gave you weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Khalaqakum Min Đa`fin Thumma Ja`ala Min Ba`di Đa`fin Quwatan Thumma Ja`ala Min Ba`di Quwatin Đa`faan Wa Shaybatan Yakhluqu Ma Yasha'u Wa Huwa Al-`Alimu Al-Qadiru

v.t: On the Day when the Hour takes place, the sinners will swear they had stayed but an hour. Thus they were deluded
v.l: Wa Yawma Taqumu As-Sa`atu Yuqsimu Al-Mujrimuna Ma Labithu Ghayra Sa`atin Kadhalika Kanu Yu'ufakuna

v.t: But those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, “You remained in God’s Book until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina 'Utu Al-`Ilma Wa Al-'Imana Laqad Labithtum Fi Kitabi Allahi 'Ila Yawmi Al-Ba`thi Fahadha Yawmu Al-Ba`thi Wa Lakinnakum Kuntum La Ta`lamuna

v.t: On that Day, the sinners’ excuses will not benefit them, nor will they be excused
v.l: Fayawma'idhin La Yanfa`u Al-Ladhina Zalamu Ma`dhiratuhum Wa La Hum Yusta`tabuna
w: will be allowed to make amends

v.t: We have cited in this Quran for the people every sort of parable. But even if you bring them a miracle, those who disbelieve will say, “You are nothing but fakers.”
v.l: Wa Laqad Đarabna Lilnnasi Fi Hadha Al-Qur'ani Min Kulli Mathalin Wa La'in Ji'tahum Bi'ayatin Layaqulanna Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'In 'Antum 'Illa Mubtiluna

v.t: God thus seals the hearts of those who do not know
v.l: Kadhalika Yatba`u Allahu `Ala Qulubi Al-Ladhina La Ya`lamuna

v.t: So be patient. The promise of God is true. And do not let those who lack certainty belittle you
v.l: Fasbir 'Inna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Wa La Yastakhiffannaka Al-Ladhina La Yuqinuna
